mapper.insert: insert into raffle_activity_stage(channel, source, activity_id, state, create_time, update_time) values ( #{channel},#{source},#{activityId},#{state},now(),now() )
mapper.update: update raffle_activity_stage set state = 'active', update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select activity_id from raffle_activity_stage where id = #{id}

select s.id, s.channel, s.source, s.activity_id, s.state, s.create_time, s.update_time, a.activity_name, a.activity_desc, a.strategy_id, a.state as activity_state, a.begin_date_time, a.end_date_time from raffle_activity_stage s left join raffle_activity a on a.activity_id = s.activity_id where s.id = #{id}

select s.id, s.channel, s.source, s.activity_id, s.state, s.create_time, s.update_time, a.activity_name, a.activity_desc, a.strategy_id, a.state as activity_state, a.begin_date_time, a.end_date_time from raffle_activity_stage s join raffle_activity a on a.activity_id = s.activity_id where s.channel = #{channel} and s.source = #{source} and s.state = 'active' and a.state = 'open' and a.begin_date_time <= now() and a.end_date_time >= now() order by s.id desc

select a.activity_id, s.id, s.channel, s.source, s.state, s.create_time, s.update_time, a.activity_name, a.activity_desc, a.strategy_id, a.state as activity_state, a.begin_date_time, a.end_date_time from raffle_activity a left join raffle_activity_stage s on s.activity_id = a.activity_id order by a.activity_id desc, s.id desc
